name: dsw-portal
description: DSW Geeta University Portal — React + Vite frontend, FastAPI backend, single Vercel deployment

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt --user --break-system-packages
